articles.title: O que falta para Aeroporto Marechal Rondon operar voos internacionais | G1
articles.standfirst: Anac autorizou o aeroporto a operar voos internacionais em 2024, mas companhias ainda avaliam fatores. Governo anunciou ligação com Buenos Aires para 2027, porém Gol diz que assinou apenas carta de intenção.
articles.summary: Anac autorizou o aeroporto a operar voos internacionais em 2024, mas companhias ainda avaliam fatores.
articles.body:
Aeroporto Marechal Rondon, em Várzea Grande (MT) — Foto: Mayke Toscano/GCOM-MT

Autorizado desde 2024 a operar voos comerciais internacionais e com cerca de R$ 280 milhões em investimentos, o Aeroporto Marechal Rondon, em Várzea Grande , região metropolitana de Cuiabá, ainda não possui nenhum voo comercial internacional regular.

O principal terminal aéreo de Mato Grosso já conta com autorização da Agência Nacional de Aviação Civil (Anac), mas a abertura de uma rota para fora do país depende de uma combinação de fatores que vai além da estrutura do aeroporto.

Segundo a Secretaria de Desenvolvimento Econômico de Mato Grosso (Sedec), as companhias aéreas analisam determinados fatores antes de decidir pela implantação de um novo voo .

Essas avaliações ajudam a explicar por que as negociações podem levar meses ou até anos e por que uma autorização para receber voos internacionais não significa, automaticamente, que alguma companhia irá operar uma rota.

“Existem alguns fatores que precisam ser avaliados pelas companhias aéreas, como demanda, viabilidade operacional e comercial da rota. Por isso, essas tratativas acabam sendo construídas ao longo do tempo”, informou a Sedec.

A internacionalização do Marechal Rondon envolveu investimentos de aproximadamente R$ 280 milhões feitos pela Centro-Oeste Airports (COA), concessionária responsável pela administração do terminal.

Apesar disso, a estrutura adequada e a autorização regulatória são apenas parte do processo. Para que um voo regular internacional saia do papel, é preciso que uma empresa aérea considere a rota economicamente sustentável.

É justamente nesse ponto que entram fatores como potencial de passageiros, ocupação dos aviões, custos operacionais, conexão com outras cidades e perspectiva de retorno financeiro.

Questionada pelo g1 sobre o andamento das negociações, a secretaria informou que a ligação com o país vizinho foi apenas uma das possibilidades avaliadas. Segundo a Sedec, a rota para o Peru “foi uma possibilidade levantada, assim como outras” durante o trabalho para atrair voos internacionais ao estado.

A Secretaria afirmou ainda que intensificou as tratativas, que já vinham sendo realizadas, com as companhias aéreas, a partir da sanção da Lei nº 13.191/2025 , que criou a subvenção econômica para implantação ou ampliação de voos internacionais com origem ou destino em Mato Grosso.

O g1 procurou a Latam para saber se a negociação continua em andamento, mas a companhia respondeu apenas que avalia de forma contínua possibilidades de ampliar de maneira sustentável a conectividade de sua malha e informa que qualquer nova operação será comunicada oportunamente.

Nesta semana, o Governo de Mato Grosso anunciou que o estado deverá ter, a partir de 2027, o primeiro voo internacional regular de passageiros com saída direta de Cuiabá . A proposta prevê uma ligação entre o Aeroporto Marechal Rondon e Buenos Aires, na Argentina , com voos semanais operados pela Gol.

A companhia, no entanto, informou ao g1 que, até o momento, foi assinada uma carta de intenção para criação da rota.

“A Gol avalia continuamente oportunidades de expandir sua malha aérea regional, nacional e internacional, conforme viabilidade econômica e de infraestrutura. A Companhia confirma que assinou uma carta de intenção para a criação da rota e esclarece que detalhes sobre a operação serão comunicados pela empresa em momento oportuno".

Na prática, isso significa que a rota ainda depende das avaliações e etapas necessárias antes de entrar efetivamente na malha da companhia. A Gol não informou, por exemplo, data de início da venda das passagens, horários, aeronaves que seriam utilizadas ou quando os voos começariam a ser operados.

💰 Entenda o incentivo criado para atrair voos internacionais

A Lei nº 13.191, citada pela Sedec, autorizou o Governo de Mato Grosso a conceder subvenção econômica a companhias que implantem ou ampliem rotas internacionais no estado. O benefício pode atender voos regulares de passageiros ou de cargas, desde que tenham Mato Grosso como origem ou destino.

Para receber o incentivo, a companhia precisa apresentar um projeto que detalhe, entre outros pontos:

análise de viabilidade econômica e financeira;

estimativa do número de passageiros e da movimentação de cargas;

taxa estimada de ocupação das aeronaves;

O incentivo poderá ser concedido por até 10 anos, com possibilidade de prorrogação após avaliação técnica. O valor total destinado pelo estado às subvenções está limitado a R$ 10 milhões por ano.

As empresas beneficiadas também deverão apresentar relatórios semestrais com informações sobre as operações e indicadores de desempenho. Caso as condições estabelecidas não sejam cumpridas, o pagamento poderá ser suspenso e até cancelado.

Aeroporto Marechal Rondon, em Várzea Grande — Foto: Reprodução

Com 70 anos desde a inauguração, o Aeroporto Internacional Marechal Rondon é o principal terminal aéreo de Mato Grosso .

O aeroporto tem capacidade para atender 5,7 milhões de passageiros por ano e uma estimativa de circulação diária de 8.967 pessoas , considerando passageiros e funcionários das empresas que atuam no sistema aeroportuário.

Em 1996, o Marechal Rondon passou a operar oficialmente como aeroporto internacional, desempenhando papel fundamental ligado à movimentação de cargas. Dez anos depois, em 2006, um novo terminal de passageiros foi inaugurado, ampliando a capacidade de atendimento.

O aeroporto integra o chamado Bloco Centro-Oeste, que inclui ainda os aeroportos de Sinop , Rondonópolis e Alta Floresta . A concessão teve início em outubro de 2019, com contrato de 30 anos. Desde então, a Centro-Oeste Airports é responsável pela administração, manutenção e modernização da infraestrutura do terminal.

Mesmo com as melhorias, a autorização para voos internacionais e os incentivos criados pelo estado, Mato Grosso ainda aguarda a primeira operação comercial internacional regular de passageiros partindo do aeroporto.

articles.standfirst: Casino GM te ofrece la apuesta combinada de la quinta jornada de LaLiga 26-27, correspondiente a los encuentros del sábado 12 de septiembre
articles.summary: Casino GM te ofrece la apuesta combinada de la quinta jornada de LaLiga 26-27, correspondiente a los encuentros del sábado 12 de septiembre
articles.body: LaLiga 26-27 sigue su curso y el sábado llega con cuatro partidos tremendamente interesantes. El Racing de Santander se enfrenta al Alavés a las 14:00. Más tarde tenemos el partido entre Osasuna y Espanyol, a las 16:15. Seguido del Athletic Club contra el Elche, a las 18:30. Y cierra la jornada, el Real Madrid contra el Rayo Vallecano a las 21:00 Pronóstico 1: Ambos equipos marcan El mercado de ambos equipos marcan aparece como una de las alternativas más interesantes del encuentro en las apuestas deportivas. El Racing acaba de anotar dos goles ante el Rayo Vallecano pese a la derrota, mientras que el Alavés, segundo clasificado tras golear 5-2 al Osasuna, ha demostrado que su ataque funciona incluso lejos de casa. Casino GM paga a 1.57 que ambos equipos marquen. Pronóstico 2: +2.5 goles totales Osasuna llega tocado tras encajar cinco goles ante el Alavés en su último compromiso, una imagen defensiva que invita a pensar en que puede volver a sufrir en su propia área. El Espanyol, por su parte, ha firmado partidos con bastante producción ofensiva en las últimas semanas, incluido el 1-1 ante el Sevilla, lo que refuerza la opción de un duelo con varios goles. Casino GM paga a 2.25 que el encuentro tenga 3 o más goles. Pronóstico 3: Gana el Athletic Club El conjunto de Terzić llega en un momentazo de forma, encadenando dos victorias consecutivas sin encajar gol, la última de ellas un contundente 3-0 ante el Atlético de Madrid. El Elche, en cambio, ocupa puestos de descenso, es la peor defensa de LaLiga con doce goles recibidos en cuatro jornadas y no gana fuera de casa desde hace cinco desplazamientos. Casino GM paga a 1.41 la victoria local. Pronóstico 4: Ambos equipos marcan El mercado de ambos equipos marcan aparece como una de las alternativas más interesantes del encuentro. El Real Madrid llega a esta quinta jornada con la sensación de que su defensa todavía tiene margen de mejora. Encajó ante el Betis pese a dominar el partido. El Rayo Vallecano, por su parte, demostró que es un equipo que genera peligro con facilidad, aunque también dejó resquicios atrás que el Racing pudo aprovechar en varias ocasiones, llegando a marcar dos goles. Casino GM paga a 2 que ambos equipos marquen La combinada propuesta para esta jornada de LaLiga reúne que ambos equipos marquen en el Racing vs Alavés (1.57), que se marquen más de 2.5 goles en el Osasuna vs Espanyol (2.25), que el Athletic le gane al Elche (1.41) y que ambos equipos marquen en el Real Madrid vs Rayo Vallecano (2). La cuota combinada asciende hasta 9.96, fruto de la multiplicación de las cuatro cuotas. articles.title: Kylian Mbappe: Dictator meme shows 'lack of awareness', says Real Madrid forward
articles.summary: Kylian Mbappe criticises a viral meme which superimposes his face on the body of a dictator, saying it shows "a lack of political and human awareness".
articles.body:
Kylian Mbappe has criticised a viral meme which superimposes his face on the body of a dictator, saying it shows "a lack of political and human awareness".

The Real Madrid and France forward, 27, said he understood there was a "funny side" to the AI-generated meme, but that it downplayed serious issues.

It is seemingly used by some fans on social media to reflect the way Mbappe dominates matches, while others have suggested it refers to his influence at clubs.

Speaking in an interview with France Football , external , Mbappe said: "There's a funny side to it because you can sense that, for some people, it's good natured.

"Then there's a side that's a bit less funny, because we know the damage people like that have caused throughout history.

"Being compared to people who murder others, or who have made millions upon millions of people miserable... I don't think I've done that in my life.

"On one hand, I know it's done lightheartedly and doesn't go that far, but it sometimes reveals a lack of political and human awareness among people."

Mbappe also referenced the "Mobut" nickname he was called by France team-mate Ousmane Dembele during the 2026 World Cup.

That nickname comes from Mobutu Sese Seko, the dictator who ruled the Democratic Republic of Congo - formerly Zaire - for three decades.

"Ousmane, that's a different thing. He took that from social media. He's just having a laugh," Mbappe said.

articles.title: Nasser Al-Thani: una década de pufos con el Málaga de fondo
articles.standfirst: El hijo del jeque tiene un historial terrorífico
articles.summary: El hijo del jeque tiene un historial terrorífico
articles.body: En 2026, el nombre de Nasser Al-Thani vuelve a aparecer ligado a asuntos económicos. El que fuera CEO del Málaga CF durante la etapa de su familia al frente del club acumula ahora otro episodio polémico: un tribunal británico ha autorizado al hotel Dorchester de Londres a recuperar parte de una deuda de 458.000 libras, unos 532.000 euros, mediante la incautación y posterior venta de un coche que dejó en el establecimiento. La actualidad de Nasser adquiere una dimensión especial en Málaga por su pasado al frente del club y por las operaciones económicas que aparecen en la documentación policial que dio lugar a la intervención judicial del Málaga. El informe preliminar de la Policía Judicial describe numerosas transferencias desde el entorno societario del club hacia empresas vinculadas a los Al-Thani y también directamente a miembros de la familia. Entre los nombres que aparecen en esas operaciones destaca precisamente Nasser. Desde 2015 se documentaron movimientos de dinero a través de Nas Football, sociedad que entonces controlaba el 96,8% del Málaga, además de otras empresas vinculadas a la familia. Según la investigación, parte de estas cantidades no estaban destinadas a las necesidades del club, sino que terminaron relacionadas con gastos particulares. Uno de los ejemplos señalados en el informe corresponde al 30 de octubre de 2015, cuando se contabilizó un pago de 11.897,64 euros a la empresa naviera Emarat Shipping INC. La operación figuraba como un gasto de Nas Football, pero la documentación policial apuntaba a que se trataba de gastos personales de Nasser, identificados expresamente como «Gastos Shk. NASSER». Cuatro días después, el 3 de noviembre, Nasser recibió 6.000 euros. Además, durante las últimas semanas de 2015, Nasser y su hermano Nayef percibieron seis transferencias por un total de 70.000 euros bajo el concepto de «anticipo de salarios». El dinero había sido recibido previamente por Nas Football procedente del Málaga, pese a que, según la documentación policial, esta sociedad no contaba con empleados registrados. Una década después, aquellos movimientos forman parte del contexto que rodea a una familia que continúa bajo el foco judicial en 2026. A la investigación sobre la gestión de los Al-Thani en el Málaga se suma ahora el episodio de Londres, donde Nasser mantiene una disputa económica por una deuda de 532.000 euros. Dos escenarios diferentes y separados en el tiempo que vuelven a situar su nombre en primera línea.

articles.title: El Madrid se rearma en una semana clave
articles.standfirst: Las bajas dan una tregua a Mourinho, que dispone de 22 jugadores para tres partidos en nueve días
articles.summary: Las bajas dan una tregua a Mourinho, que dispone de 22 jugadores para tres partidos en nueve días
articles.body: El Real Madrid venía arrastrando un problema silencioso. Un contratiempo que estaba pasando desapercibido o al que, al menos, no se le estaba dando la importancia debida. Quizá porque el obstáculo ya se había instalado en el equipo hasta tal punto de que entraba dentro de la normalidad. Pero no lo era y estaba limitando a Mourinho en el arranque de temporada. Es el problema de las bajas. El técnico ha afrontado los cinco primeros compromisos de la temporada con siete bajas en cada uno de ellos (cuatro de Liga y uno de Champions). Siete lesionados tuvo en los cuatro primeros encuentros (Mendy, Rodrygo, Militao, Tchouaméni, Thiago Pitarch, Endrick y Asencio) y ante el Inter, donde recuperaba a tres de ellos, perdía otros tres por sanción (Camavinga, Güler y Bernardo Silva). Sin un tercio de los jugadores de campo ha tenido que lidiar Mourinho hasta ahora. Un problema que toca a su fin, de momento. El Madrid se rearma en una semana clave en la que debe afrontar tres compromisos ligueros en nueve días, con final en el Metropolitano para visitar al Atlético. Todo ello con la obligación de no ceder más distancia respecto al Barcelona, que ya ha puesto tierra de por medio. Tras la novedad de Asencio ante el Rayo, las bajas dan una tregua a Mourinho, que dispone de 22 jugadores para este corto y decisivo tramo. Un subidón de recursos que permitirá al técnico tener un amplio abanico de posibilidades para elegir cada once y refrescar al equipo. "Es un grupo con fuerzas suficientes para dar oportunidad a algunas piernas con mucha gasolina y a otros darles un poco de reposo, que también es importante", celebra el técnico. Mourinho tiene a su disposición todo lo que podía tener a corto plazo, una vez que Militao, Mendy y Rodrygo son bajas de larga duración y aún tardarán un tiempo en estar disponibles. El técnico no tiene ninguna posición bajo mínimos, como ocurrió con el centro del campo ante el Inter, y tiene recursos suficientes para elegir. Precisamente las bajas fueron uno de los motivos de la mala temporada pasada. El Madrid se disparó hasta las 60 lesiones (sólo no se lesionaron Vinicius, Fran García, Gonzalo y Brahim) y hasta en 15 partidos tuvo siete bajas o más. Ante el Rayo el Madrid tendrá su cifra de bajas más reducida (3) de los últimos cinco meses. Desde el 21 de abril, ante el Alavés, el Madrid no tenía sólo tres ausencias. Rodrygo, Courtois y Asencio estaban entonces fuera de combate.

articles.title: "Llevo 40 años en el arbitraje y nunca ha habido tantos cambios en las reglas de juego"
articles.standfirst: Fernández Borbalán, director técnico del CTA, ha impartido una charla en Almería dirigida a la prensa en la que ha analizado las novedades del reglamento
articles.summary: Fernández Borbalán, director técnico del CTA, ha impartido una charla en Almería dirigida a la prensa en la que ha analizado las novedades del reglamento
articles.body: El fútbol español afronta esta temporada una de las mayores transformaciones reglamentarias de los últimos años. Así lo aseguró David Fernández Borbalán, director técnico del Comité Técnico de Árbitros (CTA), durante una charla organizada por la Asociación de Periodistas Deportivos de Almería, en la que analizó las principales novedades introducidas por la IFAB y el impacto que ya están teniendo sobre el juego. El excolegiado internacional, con cuatro décadas de experiencia en el arbitraje, reconoció que nunca había vivido un verano con tantas modificaciones. Sin embargo, considera que el balance inicial es muy positivo, especialmente por el aumento del tiempo efectivo de juego: "Hemos ganado una media de dos minutos por partido y eso ayuda al fútbol", explicó Borbalán, convencido de que las nuevas medidas benefician al espectáculo pese al esfuerzo añadido que suponen tanto para los futbolistas como para los árbitros. Entre las novedades destacan la cuenta atrás para ejecutar saques de banda y de puerta, el límite de tiempo en las sustituciones o la revisión por parte del VAR de acciones como una segunda tarjeta amarilla o la decisión entre saque de esquina y de puerta. Para el responsable técnico del CTA, el objetivo es claro: reducir las pérdidas de tiempo sin perjudicar el ritmo de los encuentros. Eso sí, aclaró que la aplicación de estas normas no será automática ni inflexible. Los árbitros tendrán margen para interpretar cada situación. Como ejemplo puso los saques de banda: si el equipo que va perdiendo tarda unos segundos más en reanudar el juego, no se sancionará salvo que la demora sea evidente. "No somos un radar en la autovía", resumió. Borbalán también explicó que el CTA ha reducido en torno a un 20% las intervenciones de VAR respecto a temporadas anteriores gracias a un equipo específico de especialistas, concretamente 15, con el reto ahora de acortar todavía más los tiempos de revisión para que las decisiones sean más ágiles. Por último, el almeriense también quiso zanjar algunas dudas surgidas tras el inicio del campeonato. Confirmó que un jugador no será expulsado simplemente por taparse la boca al hablar con un compañero o con el árbitro, salvo que exista una circunstancia excepcional que justifique una sanción disciplinaria. Además, defendió la actuación arbitral en la polémica acción del penalti señalado a favor de Mbappé frente al Betis, al considerar que la decisión fue correcta al no repetir la pena máxima. También, que la mano de Pubill en Champions ante el Barcelona la temporada pasada pasará a ser penalizada como penalti.

articles.title: Julio Salinas: "Me he alegrado de que no venga Julián Álvarez"
articles.standfirst: El ex delantero internacional, protagonista en Radio MARCA
articles.summary: El ex delantero internacional, protagonista en Radio MARCA
articles.body: Julio Salinas atendió al 'Programa de Ortega' para repasar la actualidad del Barcelona y dejó varios titulares contundentes. El exdelantero azulgrana no dudó al valorar el intento del club por hacerse con Julián Álvarez: "Me alegro de que no venga ni ahora, y ojalá no venga en enero. Para mí es un error". Salinas reconoce la enorme calidad del argentino, pero considera desproporcionada la cantidad que el Barça estaba dispuesto a invertir: "Es muy buen futbolista, nadie va a discutir su calidad, pero a mí esa cantidad de dinero me parece una exageración". En su opinión, el club azulgrana debería mejorar su política en el mercado: "Debería aprender un poco en comprar mejor y vender mejor". El exinternacional español fue todavía más contundente al poner cifras a su opinión. "La oferta que creo que hacía el Barça de 130 millones me parece demasiado dinero, demasiado dinero", aseguró. Salinas incluso explicó la operación que él habría intentado si hubiese ocupado el cargo de secretario técnico del Atlético: "Viendo la necesidad del Barça, yo hubiese intentado fichar a Ferran Torres y que me pagaran, imagínate, Ferran Torres y 80 millones. Me parecería un chollo". Una visión que contrasta con el interés del Barcelona por Julián Álvarez, cuya llegada finalmente no se produjo y que continúa en el Atlético. Salinas también quiso reivindicar el papel de Raphinha en el Barcelona, más allá de sus goles. Para el exdelantero, el brasileño es una pieza decisiva por su capacidad para presionar y contagiar al resto del equipo. "Mientras esté Raphinha bien, el papel de Raphinha en el Barça me parece decisivo", afirmó. Y explicó por qué: "Raphinha, con lo que presiona en todos los partidos, aunque vaya 5-0, hace que al final Lamine Yamal tenga que hacer lo mismo". Una importancia que se está viendo también en este inicio de temporada: Raphinha ha asumido galones y lideró con dos goles la goleada ante el Feyenoord en Champions. Y para cerrar, Salinas sorprendió con su candidato al Balón de Oro: Fabián Ruiz. Su argumento es rotundo: "Fabián lo ha ganado todo y ha sido imprescindible". El exjugador azulgrana destacó sus títulos y, especialmente, su importancia con España: "Ha ganado todos los títulos con el PSG, ha ganado el Mundial, ha ganado la Champions y encima ha sido un jugador decisivo en el Mundial". Salinas reivindicó además el mérito del centrocampista por haberse convertido en una pieza clave en el sistema de Luis de la Fuente: "El cambio táctico de Luis de la Fuente ha hecho que con Fabián, imagínate, cargarse a Pedri". Una apuesta que coloca al centrocampista español en el debate por un premio en el que este año también ha llamado la atención la ausencia de Raphinha entre los nominados.

articles.title: Zeidane Inoussa: Swansea City winger joins Gornik Zabrze on loan
articles.summary: Swansea City winger Zeidane Inoussa joins Polish club Gornik Zabrze on loan for the remainder of the season.
articles.body:
Swansea City winger Zeidane Inoussa has joined Polish top-flight club Gornik Zabrze on loan for the remainder of the season.

Inoussa came close to joining Portsmouth on English football's transfer deadline day earlier this month and was also linked with a loan move to Croatian side Osijek this week.

Inoussa is under contract at Swansea until 2030 and the Championship club have an option to recall him in January.

"We hope he makes an impact [at Gornik Zabrze]," said Swansea head coach Vitor Matos.

"He's a wonderful kid, a really good professional. He just needs game-time and consistency in playing.

"I think that's what he wants as well so it's a good option in terms of finding that. We are here for him and hopefully everything goes right."

The Swans paid a significant fee to sign Inoussa from BK Hacken in the summer of 2025, but the former Sweden Under-21s international has had a limited impact in the Championship.

Inoussa scored once in 29 Swansea appearances last season, and did not feature after January due to a stress fracture in his back.

With competition in Matos' squad fierce for game-time out wide, Inoussa has not been involved in a matchday squad in 2026-27.

articles.title: La bomba que prepara James tras su llegada a Atlético Nacional: Su retiro de la Selección Colombia
articles.standfirst: James Rodríguez llega a Atlético Nacional entre la ilusión y la zozobra de un posible adiós a la Tricolor
articles.summary: James Rodríguez llega a Atlético Nacional entre la ilusión y la zozobra de un posible adiós a la Tricolor
articles.body: El fútbol colombiano vive días convulsos y cargados de emociones. La contratación de James Rodríguez por Atlético Nacional sacudió el mercado de pases local, marcando el regreso del cucuteño al Fútbol Profesional Colombiano (FPC) tras 18 años de carrera internacional. Sin embargo, el entusiasmo por su vinculación al cuadro verdolaga se ha visto envuelto en un torbellino de versiones sobre lo que podría ser la decisión más impactante de su carrera: su retiro definitivo de la Selección Colombia. Atlético Nacional oficializó el fichaje de James Rodríguez como libre sobre el cierre del mercado de pases. Tras finalizar su vínculo con el Minnesota United de la MLS y sonar en el radar de clubes de Italia y México, el capitán de la Tricolor optó por vestir la camiseta verdolaga. La ceremonia oficial ante la afición está programada para este domingo en el Estadio Atanasio Girardot de Medellín, antes del compromiso de Liga BetPlay frente a Águilas Doradas. Rodríguez requerirá alrededor de dos semanas de acondicionamiento físico antes de debutar oficialmente, tras varios meses sin competencia en clubes desde mayo. La información entregada por la periodista Sheyla García en Win Sports sugiere que el cucuteño podría aprovechar la atención mediática de su vinculación a Nacional y una conferencia de prensa paralela para anunciar su retiro de la Selección Colombia. Tras la participación en el Mundial 2026, la Tricolor iniciará un nuevo ciclo de recambio generacional bajo la dirección técnica de Néstor Lorenzo. James consideraría dar el relevo a nuevas figuras como Luis Díaz y Richard Ríos. Fuentes del entorno cercano al jugador desmintieron que exista una decisión tomada para retirarse y sostienen que el mediocampista mantiene vivo el deseo de competir en la Copa América 2028. Por ahora, la expectativa es máxima entre la afición colombiana, que aguarda las palabras oficiales de James Rodríguez durante su evento de presentación en Medellín para disipar las dudas sobre su futuro vistiendo la camiseta número 10 de la Selección.

articles.title: El Eibar afronta un desafío mayúsculo: cuatro de sus próximos cinco partidos, a domicilio
articles.standfirst: A Aranbarri no le asusta el calendario próximo de su equipo, que visitará a Celta Fortuna, Eldense, Albacete y Oviedo en el próximo mes de competición
articles.summary: A Aranbarri no le asusta el calendario próximo de su equipo, que visitará a Celta B, Eldense, Albacete y Oviedo en el próximo mes de competición
articles.body: Tres triunfos consecutivos han disparado la moral de un Eibar que no quiere parar. Para ello, el cuadro armero deberá dar su mejor versión como visitante, porque el calendario le lleva lejos de Ipurua en cuatro de las siguientes cinco jornadas. Celta Fortuna, Eldense, Albacete y Oviedo serán los rivales a los que rendirá visita en las próximas semanas. Entre medias, el duelo ante Las Palmas en el único encuentro en casa hasta mediados de octubre. A Aranbarri no le asusta el desafío. "Nosotros estamos convencidos de que fuera vamos a ir a por los partidos, que vamos a intentar llevar la iniciativa, y lo llevamos con total naturalidad. El hecho de que vayamos a jugar ahora cuatro partidos de cinco fuera de casa lo tomamos con naturalidad, no le damos muchas vueltas. Ya hemos demostrado en Andorra, ante un rival realmente complicado, que ganamos el partido manteniendo la portería a cero, con casi 40 minutos con un jugador menos". El Eibar no quiere frenar su dinámica pese a las numerosas salidas que tiene a la vuelta de la esquina. "La racha ayuda para seguir creyendo. Es realmente importante que los jugadores estén convencidos de lo que hacen. Los resultados ayudan a seguir creyendo, pero lo que sí tenemos claro y creo que es una fuerza del equipo es que creen en lo que hacen. Un resultado no nos va a cambiar el foco ni la manera de entender el juego", explica Aranbarri. El preparador armero ha destacado las múltiples oportunidades que tiene dentro de la plantilla, pese a las numerosas bajas con las que está lidiando en el arranque de curso. "Es un aspecto que seguramente demuestra que la plantilla es muy completa, que todos están preparados. Aquí no se regala nada y si están jugando tantos es porque en el momento creemos que los necesitamos. Además, demuestran que en cada momento están dando el nivel, tanto los que salen de inicio cuando cambiamos los onces como cuando el contexto cambia de un partido a otro".

articles.title: Real Madrid’s Mbappe: AI dictator memes show lack of political awareness
articles.summary: France international and World Cup record holder Kylian Mbappe speaks out over memes using his image.
articles.body:
Kylian Mbappe did not fully enjoy the flurry of AI memes depicting him as a dictator on social media during the World Cup.

The France star was portrayed in military outfits, sitting on a throne or posing next to Soviet leader Josef Stalin and other controversial leaders.

Asked by France Football magazine how he felt about the memes, Mbappe acknowledged the humour, but said he did not like being compared to figures associated with tragedies.

“There’s a part of it that’s funny because you can tell that, for some people, it’s good-natured,” he said.

“There’s also a part that’s a little less funny because we know the damage that people like that have caused throughout history. Being compared to people who murder others, or who have made millions and millions of people miserable … I don’t think I’ve done that in my life. So there’s a mixture of things.”

The France striker, whose 22 all-time World Cup goals overtook Lionel Messi’s record, added, “I know it’s done in a light-hearted way and that it doesn’t go that far, but sometimes it shows a lack of political and human awareness among people.”

Mbappe was reminded that his France teammate Ousmane Dembele gave him the nickname “Mobut,” a reference to the former tight-fisted leader Mobutu Sese Seko of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

“With Ousmane, it’s something is different,” Mbappe said. “He picked it up from social media. With him, it’s just a joke.”

articles.title: 2030 World Cup: Moroccan prime minister tells football chief to 'stop making promises' over final
articles.summary: Morocco's prime minister tells the head of the country's football federation to stop making promises about the 2030 World Cup final, while the head of the Spanish federation says the showpiece should be played in Spain.
articles.body:
Morocco's prime minister has told the head of the country's football federation to stop making promises about the 2030 World Cup final as Spain says they should stage it.

The next men's World Cup will be co-hosted by Morocco, Spain and Portugal, although the opening three matches will be played in Uruguay, Argentina and Paraguay to mark the competition's 100th anniversary.

While a list of host stadiums has been proposed, the line-up has yet to be finalised, as well as where the showpiece will take place.

Fouzi Lekjaa, president of the Moroccan football federation (RMFF), declared at a political party event Casablanca would have the 'honour' of hosting the game.

Fifa, world football's governing body and organisers of the World Cup, said "a decision will be made in due course".

At a rally, Morocco's prime minister Aziz Akhannouch also told Lekjaa: "Do not offer to host the big final game in Morocco while we still have not discussed the matter with our allies, Spain and Portugal."

"There should be some respect, brothers. Stop using electoral promises to pull the rug out from under us. These are huge matters. Deciding where the final will be held is a major issue."

Rafael Louzan, president of the Spanish football federation (RFEF), has previously said the final will be held in Spain, and felt their claim has been strengthened by winning the men's World Cup for the second time this summer.

"Even though no decision has been taken, I believe Spain is the place because it cannot be any other way," he told Cadena SER radio station. "As you know, we are currently world champions.

"I believe Spain's organisational capacity for major events is beyond question and that is why reality dictates that the grand final cannot and must not be held anywhere other than in Spain."

Spain beat Argentina to win this year's World Cup in July, although New Jersey was not confirmed as the host for the final until February 2024 - two years before the tournament took place.

Morocco are constructing a proposed 115,000-seat stadium, which would make it the largest football stadium in the world.

In Spain, Real Madrid's Bernabeu Stadium has recently been renovated and now holds 83,000, while the capacity at Barcelona's Spotify Camp Nou will be 105,000 once renovations there are complete.

El delantero cedido por el Real Madrid estaba haciendo un buen partido, pero su eclosión vino en los minuto 29' y 30' (concretamente hizo las dos dianas en un minuto y 36 segundos). articles.title: Nick Saban Shades Big Ten for Having '3 Good Teams' Compared to SEC After AP Top 25 Poll Release
articles.summary: College GameDay analyst and ex-college football coach Nick Saban provided his honest assessment on the SEC and Big Ten's depth during his Pat McAfee Show appearance on Friday (h/t Daniel Hager of On3).
articles.body:
College GameDay analyst and ex-college football coach Nick Saban provided his honest assessment on the SEC and Big Ten's depth during his Pat McAfee Show appearance on Friday (h/t Daniel Hager of On3).

"We've already got nine teams in the Top 25," Saban said. "It's not like the Big Ten where there's three good teams at the top and then nothing."

The SEC teams in the latest AP poll are as follows:

The Big Ten has three teams in the top six (No. 1 Ohio State, No. 5 Indiana, No. 6 Oregon) and seven in the Top 25 overall (No. 14 USC, No. 16 Penn State, No. 19 Washington and No. 21 Iowa round out the group).

Saban was a head coach in the SEC for 22 years (five for LSU, 17 for Alabama), winning seven national championships. He also coached Michigan State for five seasons (1995-1999), among other teams during an illustrious coaching career.

So Saban may have a natural SEC bias, but he's right about the depth. The SEC has seven teams in the top 12 alone, and it's not impossible to see any of them competing for a national championship in June. Per FanDuel Sportsbook , 13 teams have odds at 25-1 or shorter to win it all, and all seven of those SEC teams are there.

Still, the Big Ten can show some more depth this year. Of note, USC will have its chances to show its strength with games against OSU, Oregon and Indiana later this year. Penn State got the Matt Campbell era off to a strong start with a 45-0 win over Marshall.

In the meantime, it's clear Ohio State, Indiana and Oregon showcase their own strengths, thanks in part to their fantastic passing attacks. They carry the Big Ten flags right now in a national championship chase.

Saturday features a massive Big Ten-SEC game when No. 1 OSU visits No. 4 Texas, which should at least count for some conference-pride bragging rights. Kickoff is at 7:30 p.m. ET in Austin.

articles.title: Fenerbahce: Ismail Kartal still head coach despite resigning after Roma game
articles.summary: Ismail Kartal remains as head coach of Fenerbahce, despite resigning following Thursday's Champions League game with Roma.
articles.body:
Ismail Kartal remains head coach of Fenerbahce, despite saying he had resigned following Thursday's Champions League tie with Roma.

Minutes after the 1-1 home draw, the 65-year-old said he planned never to return to the club he previously served as a player and assistant coach.

But Fenerbahce president Aziz Yildirim later said in a statement on the Turkish club's website , external he had not accepted Kartal's resignation.

The club, who face Gaziantep FK in a Turkish Super Lig game on Monday, also confirmed he was still in charge in a statement on Friday.

The statement read: , external "Our team will continue its preparations for the Gaziantep FK match with the training session to be held tomorrow (Saturday) at 11:30 under the direction of our technical director Ismail Kartal."

Kartal took over for a fourth spell as head coach in June as the club returned to the Champions League for the first time in 18 years.

Before Monday's game, his side are ninth in the Super Lig with six points from four games and their next Champions League group-phase tie is at Aston Villa on 14 October.

Yildirim confirmed in his earlier statement he spoke to Kartal following the news conference, with the coach citing "pressure" of the role and a mid-match incident where he was struck by a bottle thrown from the stands as factors in his decision.

In a post on social media, the club said a spectator involved in the bottle incident had been identified and banned from the stadium.

"You can't show support by throwing punches at him like this," added Yildirim.

"Ismail Kartal doesn't need to say he'll continue. I am his senior. I said he'll continue, and that's it. We're a family."

articles.title: Luis García Plaza se encara con el micrófono de DAZN durante una pausa de hidratación
articles.standfirst: "¡Es que no quiero que el equipo contrario se entere de lo que voy a decir!", gritó para manifestar su disgusto
articles.summary: "¡Es que no quiero que el equipo rival se entere de lo que voy a decir!", gritó para manifestar su disgusto
articles.body: La pausa de hidratación de la primera parte dejó una de las imágenes más llamativas del partido Sevilla - Valencia cuando el entrenador del equipo local, Luis García Plaza, mostró abiertamente su malestar con la presencia de un micrófono demasiado cerca de la charla táctica que pretendía mantener con sus jugadores. La escena se produjo mientras los futbolistas aprovechaban el parón para recibir instrucciones en la línea de banda. En ese momento, una pértiga de sonido, se aproximó a la zona donde el técnico se disponía a hablar con sus hombres. Luis García Plaza advirtió rápidamente la situación y se detuvo momentáneamente antes de comenzar sus explicaciones. El entrenador observó en varias ocasiones tanto a la cámara de televisión como al profesional encargado de sostener la pértiga. Tras comprobar que ambos seguían situados cerca del corrillo de jugadores, decidió cambiar de ubicación la conversación. Con evidente gesto de disgusto, llamó a sus futbolistas para alejarse de la zona en la que se encontraba el micrófono y les indicó: "¡Venid para acá!". Sin embargo, el episodio no terminó ahí. Una vez desplazado el grupo, Luis García Plaza quiso dejar constancia de su enfado de forma pública. Mirando hacia arriba, en dirección al propio micrófono y consciente de que sus palabras iban a ser captadas por la realización televisiva, alzó la voz para protestar por la situación. "¡Es que no quiero que se entere el equipo contrario de lo que voy a decir, ya está, solo eso!", exclamó el técnico en dos ocasiones, insistiendo en su disgusto con que una conversación de carácter táctico pudiera ser recogida por el sonido ambiente de la retransmisión. El técnico cerró el corrillo en torno a él y comenzó su charla explicando cómo estaba dispuesto el Valencia, pero luego bajó el volumen de la voz y no se oyó nada más de forma inteligible.

articles.title: Karrikaburu hace de El Plantío su jardín
articles.standfirst: Gol y asistencia de tacón en su primer partido como titular con el Burgos, que remontó para derrotar a un Ceuta que sigue sin puntuar
articles.summary: Gol y asistencia de tacón en su primer partido como titular con el Burgos, que remontó para derrotar a un Ceuta que sigue sin puntuar
articles.body: El Burgos le dio la vuelta al partido ante el Ceuta en apenas media hora y con Jon Karrikaburu como gran protagonista. El delantero, recién llegado a El Plantío, marcó su primer tanto como blanquinegro para completar una remontada que empezó con un golazo de Alberto Dadie y terminó con la fortuna del rebote en el tercero. El Ceuta había entrado mejor al partido. El Burgos esperaba atrás y dejaba que los caballas manejaran el balón, cómodos pero sin encontrar la manera de hacer daño. Hasta que apareció Cantero. Sevikyan se coló por la izquierda, su centro tocó en un defensa y el balón cayó a Kuki Zalazar, que fusiló desde la frontal. El portero burgalés sacó una mano espectacular para evitar el 0-1. No pudo hacer nada poco después. Córner al área pequeña y Carlos Hernández ganó la posición para cabecear a la red. El Ceuta encontraba premio a su buen inicio, pero la alegría le duró poco. La respuesta del Burgos fue inmediata y tuvo acento de Zubieta. Karrikaburu recibió, dejó el balón de tacón y Dadie apareció desde atrás para reventarlo desde fuera del área. Un latigazo imposible para Pedro López y vuelta a empezar. Y entonces apareció él. Karrikaburu inició el contragolpe, David González condujo con inteligencia, esperó a que la defensa se cerrara y puso el pase de la muerte. El navarro llegó a tiempo, batió a Pedro López y firmó su estreno goleador con el Burgos. El Ceuta intentó reaccionar. Camacho probó de nuevo a Cantero desde la frontal, pero el Burgos tenía el partido de cara y volvió a encontrar el gol, esta vez con una dosis importante de fortuna. Galdames armó el disparo desde fuera del área y el balón fue encontrando obstáculos hasta acabar dentro. Primero tocó en Bodiger y después en Redru, cambiando por completo su trayectoria antes de colarse en la portería del Ceuta y poner el 3-1 definitivo. Del 0-1 al 3-1 en un abrir y cerrar de ojos. El Burgos había sobrevivido al dominio inicial del Ceuta y convirtió El Plantío en una fiesta con Karrikaburu como protagonista. Los caballas no levantan cabeza. Siguen sin puntuar después de cinco jornadas, seguirán siendo colistas de LaLiga Hypermotion y ya han encajado 15 tantos. Ahora tendrán dos partidos seguidos en el Alfonso Murube para tratar de enderezar el rumbo.

articles.title: PLAYER RATINGS | Rennes 1-0 Marseille: Les Rouge et Noir go top of Ligue 1 as OM concede third straight loss
articles.summary: Ligue 1 McDonald’s, Matchday 4, 11/09/26Adrien Thomasson’s second-half goal is enough for Rennes to secure a third straight win to go top of Ligue 1. Meanwhi...
articles.body:
Ligue 1 McDonald's, Matchday 4, 11/09/26

Adrien Thomasson 's second-half goal is enough for Rennes to secure a third straight win to go top of Ligue 1. Meanwhile, Bruno Genesio's Marseille woes deepened with a third consecutive loss.

Marseille returned to Rennes' Roazhon Park for the first time since the infamous dressing room brawl between Adrien Rabiot and Jonathan Rowe . So much has changed since for Les Phocéens , including the manager with Bruno Genesio making his return in Brittany after coaching Les Rouge et Noir between 2021 and 2023. Both teams were on opposite momentums. Rennes were targeting top spot whereas Marseille looked to avert a third straight Ligue 1 loss.

Still, Marseille put on a good show in the first half, playing with the handbrake off but without losing team structure. Pierre-Emile Höjbjerg pulled the strings from midfield, and Marseille's wide men put Rennes on the backfoot. Up front, the hosts were toothless. The attackers looked like they played together for the first time, leaving Estéban Lepaul in no man's land.

The best chances fell to Marseille. Brice Samba was alert to catch a goalward effort from Igor Paixão. The France international parried away a long-range Timothy Weah effort, and Pierre-Emile Höjbjerg could only find Samba's side-netting. Franck Haise shook things up in hooking Issa Soumaré for Musa Al-Tamari. The Jordan international instantly brought pace and energy to Rennes' ailing attack.

The winger found himself at the receiving end of an inviting cross from Ludovic Blas . Al-Tamari outmuscled Timothy Weah to steer the ball towards the unmarked Adrien Thomasson, who volleyed in the opener. Minutes before, Angel Gomes spurned a glorious chance to hand OM the lead…

Al-Tamari and Thomasson combined again to almost devastating effet, but this time, the crossbar kept Thomasson's attempt out. Marseille hit the woodwork too, courtesy of Anthony Rouault deflecting Paixão's header.

Despite the introductions of fresh blood, ergo fringe players that weren't even there last season like Neal Maupay or Faris Moumbagna , Marseille showed too little to worry Rennes. Les Bretons showed their craft in game management to secure a third straight win. Franck Haise's Bretons have poached 10 points out of a possible 12.

A very serious performance from France's international goalkeeper. The former Nottingham Forest ditched out important saves in both halves to preserve Rennes' first clean sheet of the Ligue 1 season.

The former Lens midfielder was partly to blame for Rennes' stuttering attack in the first half, given how little influence he had. He made amends for it, and then some, by opening his Ligue 1 account for Rennes – his 50th goal in France's first tier. His experience was vital in the closing stages to see off the win.

The former Le Havre centre-forward is definitely not a winger, and it showed again. He brought no pace, misplaced countless passes and lost most of his duels. No Rennes player lost more possession than him in the first half. A performance so woeful that it was cut short by Haise at half-time. His substitute Musa Al-Tamari (7) showed what a winger is all about with an all-energy display, capped by an assist.

The Rennes centre-forward missed the opportunity to shine before Zinédine Zidane's maiden squad announcement next Friday. Still, he didn't shy of his defensive duties and showed glimpses of how much he improved in his hold-up play.

The English centre-back badly struggled in recent weeks, but he retains Bruno Genesio's faith, until when though? The way he let Thomasson roam free into his penalty box screams of a player devoid of confidence.

The former Manchester United midfielder looks the shadow of the player he once was, even recently at Lille . He wasted a massive chance to give Marseille the lead, seconds before Thomasson's opener. Unreliable.

He is a great player," he said after the Champions League win against Villarreal in an interview with Amazon Prime.

You can see what else the two say about each other here in the video.

Coach Kovač was also full of praise after the win against the Spaniards. Fabio Silva repeatedly worked his way into big chances and rewarded himself for his efforts. "You can see that we can play just as well with this system of two strikers as we can with one striker. If, alongside Serhou (Guirassy, editor's note), we now also get Fabio (Silva, editor's note) going too — and we will — then we'll really have something to work with," said the BVB coach happily.

Few would probably have expected this kind of praise for the Portuguese player at the moment. In the summer, there were rumors of a move because Silva had only rarely been able to meet expectations. According to Sky, the Bundesliga club would have been open to talks starting at a fee of 20 million euros. Both a loan and a sale were considered.

Only a year ago, they had signed him from Wolves for 22.5 million euros. There were also said to have been offers, with clubs from Spain, the Netherlands, and Portugal apparently interested. But the striker ultimately turned them down himself. Instead, it was said that he wanted to establish himself with the black-and-yellows.

In doing so, he may also have prevented a move by Jamie Leweling to Dortmund. Shortly before the end of the transfer window, those in charge are said to have considered a deal, but only if Silva had been sold. As Sky reports, Kovač in particular was seen as a major supporter of the transfer.

Silva, for his part, did not let his coach's comments about the striker situation get him down either. Instead of sulking, he put in extra work and made his case as a super sub. In his first four competitive appearances, all as a substitute, he has already recorded four goal contributions (three goals, one assist) and noticeably injected life into the attack every single time.

The bosses are pleased with that. "It's a good feeling when you know you have a player like that sitting on the bench. That can make the difference," Lars Ricken said after the Champions League match. Ole Book also had nothing but praise for his performances and gave Silva hope of more minutes: "If Fabio performs the way he has in the last few matches, then of course he is underlining his ambitions for more playing time."

That means the old understanding of roles is starting to shake considerably. Within just a few weeks, the former "challenger" has become an indispensable factor. Niko Kovač now has to fundamentally rethink the striker hierarchy from the start of the season. Silva has fought his way from backup to a true equal partner. And who knows — maybe the two of them will line up as a strike duo against Paderborn.

articles.title: Schalke beat Union to claim first Bundesliga win in three years
articles.summary: Schalke claimed their first Bundesliga win in more than three years with a 2-1 victory against Union Berlin on Friday evening. The club from Gelsenkirchen is...
articles.body:
Schalke claimed their first Bundesliga win in more than three years with a 2-1 victory against Union Berlin on Friday evening.

The club from Gelsenkirchen is making its comeback to the top tier after three seasons in the second division. In their first two matches, they lost to Augsburg and heroically held champions Bayern Munich to a goalless draw.

Veteran Robin Gosens broke the deadlock in the 25th minute, but didn't celebrate scoring against his former club.

Leopold Querfeld thought he had cleared a cross to the box, but he ended up serving Gosens, whose superb volley-kick hit the ground before falling into the net.

Schalke could have doubled their lead in the 33rd, but Adil Aouchiche 's effort was cleared by Tom Rothe almost on the line.

Aouchiche, however, got another chance early in the second half and didn't miss this one. He played a neat one-two with Junior Adamu before smashing the ball into the net in the 46th.

He was initially flagged for offside, but the goal was confirmed after video review.

Union started showing signs of a reaction. Loris Karius was forced into a superb save to paw away Andras Schäfer's powerful drive from close range in the 55th, and Rothe hit the bar just a minute later.

But as the hosts were building momentum, the game was interrupted in the 60th minute due to a curious situation: referee Timo Gerach needed to receive treatment on his right calf, but couldn't continue the game.

The match resumed eight minutes later with Jarno Wienefeld as the new referee.

Due to the interruption, the game had 12 minutes of added time and Tim Skarke pulled one back for Union six minutes in, but Maximilian Wöber sealed the win for Schalke with the last act of the game.

articles.standfirst: El delantero argentino firma un 'hat-trick' en el primer triunfo de su equipo en cuatro jornadas
articles.summary: El delantero argentino firma un 'hat-trick' en el primer triunfo de su equipo en cuatro jornadas
articles.body: Franco Mastantuono fue el verdadero protagonista en la primera victoria de la Fiorentina en cuatro jornadas de la Serie A. El argentino se salió con tres goles que alivian un poco la precaria situación que tenía el equipo 'viola' y que terminó esta semana con la destitución de su anterior técnico, Grosso, tras tres derrotas. Pero, ya con el nuevo 'míster' Vanoli en el banquillo, Mastantuono tuvo una noche extraordinaria (su mejor actuación en Europa), remontando en sólo un minuto y 36 segundos el gol inicial de Adams para el Venecia. El argentino, con dos zurdazos desde fuera del área casi idénticos, puso el 1-2 antes de ir al descanso. En la segunda parte, y con el jugador cedido por el Real Madrid en el campo, otro argentino, Mateo Pellegrino, hijo del entrenador Mauricio, puso el 1-3 en un contragolpe. Eso sí, la fiesta de Mastantuono seguiría con una buena jugada dentro del área para poner el 1-4 y el tercero en su cuenta particular. Espectacular. Más allá de los tres goles, 'Mastan' fue el mejor del partido, con siete remates a puerta, una amarilla provocada y siendo muy superior a sus rivales en el flanco derecho del ataque florentino. La Fiore, con buenas actuaciones también de los españoles David de Gea y Alex Jiménez como lateral, se coloca ahora con tres puntos en cuatro partidos ligueros, aliviando su situación liguera.

articles.title: Richarlison: Tottenham forward's move to Vasco da Gama falls through
articles.summary: Tottenham forward Richarlison's proposed move to Vasco da Gama falls through amid ongoing uncertainty over the Brazilian's future.
articles.body:
Tottenham forward Richarlison's proposed move to Vasco da Gama has fallen through amid ongoing uncertainty over the Brazilian's future.

Sources have suggested Spurs had agreed a fee with Vasco over a return to Brazil for the 29-year-old.

However, personal terms over the deal are understood to have emerged as an issue.

The Brazil transfer window closes on Friday night and there is an emerging sense Richarlison will stay at Spurs.

The attacker has been left out of Tottenham 's Premier League squad after his proposed £35m deadline-day move to Everton broke down over a disagreement on personal terms.

Tottenham boss Roberto de Zerbi did not provide any update on Richarlison's future at a news conference earlier on Friday.

"I don't know," he said. "It's not my job."

Richarlison is understood to be exploring his options, with sources indicating he is keen to be released from the remainder of his current deal, which runs out next summer - but Spurs can also trigger a 12-month extension.

De Zerbi added: "What I can say is I know very well what the club has done for Richarlison and I know very well what Richarlison has done for the club in the last month, two months.

"I know, the club knows, he knows, his agent knows. Everyone knows better than you [the media]. Much better."

articles.title: Schalke with three goals, three points, and first Bundesliga win in three years
articles.summary: On a cloudy, seventeen-degree evening in the federal capital, 1. FC Union Berlin (0-1-1, 15th) played host to FC Schalke 04 (0-1-1, 14th) in the third matchw...
articles.body:
On a cloudy, seventeen-degree evening in the federal capital, 1. FC Union Berlin (0-1-1, 15th) played host to FC Schalke 04 (0-1-1, 14th) in the third matchweek of their 2026/27 Bundesliga campaigns at Stadion An der Alten Försterei.

Union Berlin, in their eighth Bundesliga season, managed to draw Eintracht Frankfurt 3-3 on the opening matchweek, but failed to land a single shot on target in an 0-4 defeat to Bayer 04 Leverkusen last weekend. As for Schalke, who return to the Bundesliga for the first time since 2022/23, they lost their opener 0-3 to FC Augsburg but managed to follow it with a scoreless draw against the reigning German champions, FC Bayern München .

This is the seventh meeting between the two sides in their histories, with the current head-to-head record an even 1-4-1. Schalke's lone win came in 2019/20, a 2-1 result at Veltins-Arena - Union's only victory was a dominant 6-1 result in the 2022/23 season, with that match also having been played in Gelsenkirchen. With the other sixteen teams yet to play their third matches, the winning side from this match would move up to seventh place in the table, and will likely be in the middle of the table by the time that all matches are complete on Sunday.

The hosts, in red, would kick off the match and go left to right in the opening term, with Schalke, in blue, going right to left when on the attack. It would take ten minutes for the visitors to get the first chance, as a through ball from Robin Gosens on the left side of the Union half would reach Kenan Karaman at the edge of the box. The Turkish striker and team captain saw enough space to direct a shot towards the top-left corner, and did not miss by much, as his right-footed attempt went over the hands of a jumping Frederik Rønnow and slightly over the bar.

Schalke would win a corner just five minutes later, whipped in near-post by Adil Aouchiche ; the cross would be met by a powerful header from Dejan Ljubičić, but the Austrian attacking midfielder would send the ball well above the top-right corner and out of play. Aouchiche would then get another chance of his own in the nineteenth minute, but his right-footed curler towards the top-left corner was fantastically denied by a leaping Rønnow.

Around that same time, Ljubičić's leg was caught by the boot of Aljoscha Kemlein in a challenge on the right side of the Union penalty area, and that caused the former to immediately request an early substitution due to injury concerns. Not willing to take any risks to a key player early in the season, Miron Muslić made a substitution, replacing the 28-year-old with 25-year-old France-born Cameroonian winger Junior Dina Ebimbe.

In the twenty-fourth minute, a cross from Soufiane El-Faouzi, from the right side of the Union half, deflected off the head of Leopold Querfeld and headed towards Robin Gosens - who volleyed the ball off the inside of the right post and into the bottom-left corner to give Schalke their first Bundesliga goal since promotion back to the top division. As big as the moment was for Gosens, who grew up a Schalke supporter, his celebrations were quite muted as it came against the club he played 31 matches for between 2023 and 2025 - but nevertheless, the visitors jumped in front on just their second shot on target at the Alte Försterei.

Union Berlin would follow with two chances in the minutes that followed: the first, a rolling shot into the gloves of Loris Karius courtesy Emmanuel Latte Lath, and the second, a cross from Croatian right-back Josip Juranović that was comfortably met by the hands of the 33-year-old German goalkeeper.

Schalke would go the other way, with a slicing through ball from Karaman reaching Aouchiche in a 2v1 opportunity. Aouchiche would send the ball past the left leg of Rønnow and rolling towards the line, but Tom Rothe would run into the open space in the goal area and hoof the ball well away from danger. Schalke would maintain possession in the minute that followed, and would create yet another close chance, as a shot from Junior Adamu on the right side of the box was blocked by the same leg of the 34-year-old Danish goalkeeper.

Four minutes from halftime, Aebischer launched a shot from distance, falling into the hands of Karius at the centre of the goal; this was followed by a similar, although more tame, attempt from El-Faouzi on the other side, one that Rønnow had no problem grabbing onto. Head official Timo Gerach would call both sides to the locker rooms after two minutes of first half stoppage time, with the Nordrhein-Westfalen side ahead by a goal to none.

Die Königsblauen were the better side in the opening term, outshooting Union 12-5 and 5-2 on target. Possession went 66% to Union, who also had a 15% better pass accuracy - 77% on 191 completions to 62% on just 81. The most notable statistic was touches in the opposing penalty area: despite getting the majority of the chances, they finished the opening term with just two more touches, sixteen compared to Union's fourteen.

Karaman would make the opening kick of the second half, playing the ball back to Karius who would punt it long. Within thirty seconds, the ball landed into the right side of the box on a long ball from Ebimbe, landing in front of Adamu - who then set up Aouchiche to his right for a powerful right-footed shot inside the box that went off the bottom of the bar and over the line.

The flag went up for an apparent offside, but the review with video assistants Nicolas Winter and Justus Zorn eventually proved Aouchiche to be slightly onside at the time of the pass. Thus, Gerach's final decision was that the goal stood; and Schalke were now ahead by two goals to none.

Marin Ljubičić, who entered in one of two changes for Mauro Lustrinelli's Union to begin the second half, nearly pulled the hosts back within one just four minutes later. His right-footed shot from distance went past a couple of Schalke defenders, but a diving Karius was able to grab on with both hands. The other entrant, András Schäfer, had a chance of his own in the fifty-third minute, but Karius managed to punch it away with both hands.

In the fifty-fifth minute, Rani Khedira would make his way into the right side of the Schalke third before lifting a cross towards the left side of the goal area. Rothe got into the space, leaping above Nikola Katić to meet the ball - but his towering header went off the top of the bar and out for a goal kick. Jeong Woo-yeong hoped to create a similar chance from another left-footed cross a minute and a half later, but Karius read the play well, latching onto the ball with both hands.

For the second time in Union's three matches, the match had to be halted due to an injury with an official. This time, it was the head referee, Timo Gerach, who appeared to be suffering issues with his right leg; after a seven minute delay, he went into the tunnel to receive assistance. It was ultimately determined in the sixty-seventh minute that 28-year-old fourth official Jarno Wienefeld would take over the main duties, eventually resuming play with a drop ball to the hosts two minutes later; Alexander Sather and Patrick Kessel remained on the sidelines.

Wienefeld's first task of the day was to hand Marin Ljubičić a yellow card; not for the initial foul, which was a trip of the right leg of Katić, but for the reaction of the Croatian striker after the free kick was awarded. Uduokhai would then take the third yellow card of the evening for the hosts, sending Aouchiche to the ground while the latter shielded the ball from a clean sliding tackle..

In the eighty-second minute, Schalke would have a dangerous opportunity to increase their lead to three. It started with a failed clearance from Uduokhai, bouncing off the back of his head and back into the left side of the box for Aouchiche. From there, Aouchiche flicked a pass with the outside of his right boot to the penalty spot, where Adamu was placed for a one-on-one opportunity; the Austrian right midfielder tried to pick out the bottom-left corner, but Rønnow stretched out the right leg to knock it away.

Union would make them pay in the sixth of twelve additional stoppage time minutes, cutting the deficit in half. Rothe won a headed challenge against Ebimbe, setting up former Schalke attacking midfielder Tim Skarke , who was brought into the match for Latte Lath fifteen minutes earlier. Skarke hit a powerful left-footed volley past a charging Karius, off the inside of the bar, down and over the line.

In the eighth minute, a chance at the centre of the goal area from Rani Khedira was blocked by the leg of a sliding Vitalie Becker. Karius, who dove to the left, could not get up in time to face the rebound attempt from Skarke - but did just enough to prevent the equaliser by punching the ball away with both hands.

Two minutes later, Maximilian Wöber would secure Schalke's first victory in the Bundesliga since 5. May 2023 (3-2 at 1. FSV Mainz 05 ), taking a pass from Hwang Hee-chan into the centre of the box from the right side of the Union third before smashing the ball into the bottom-right corner.

That would be the last kick of the match, as Schalke won their first match against Union since 29. November 2019, taking this one by three goals to one and moving up seven places for now, all the way up to seventh in the table. Schalke will look to earn their first winning record in the Bundesliga since 17. January 2020 (9-6-3), as they face another recently-promoted side in SV 07 Elversberg on Sunday, 20. September, with kickoff set for 17.30 (CET).

As for 1. FC Union Berlin, who remain fifteenth in the table, they will play the primetime match next Friday, looking to create a shocking result against FC Bayern München at Allianz Arena; kickoff for that match is set for 20.30 (CET).

This time, La Viola could count on one of their new signings to carry them to victory.

On loan from Real Madrid , Franco Mastantuono produced a stunning hat-trick, including two goals in the space of a single minute (29th, 30th, 84th).
